newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar March freight differentials.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar March freight differentials.

text.p: The London Internaitonal Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) issued new freight differentials for its white sugar contract to cover the March delivery period.

The exchange notice showed the following premiums - Inchon $6 a tonne ($3 in December), Ulsan $4 ($3), Bangkok/Kohsichang $1 (zero), Guangzhou, Huangpu, Shekou and Xiamen all $3 ($2), Recife and Maceio $3 ($5), Santos $10 ($13), Imbituba/Itajai $8 ($11), Buenos Aires $8 ($9), New Orleans $8 ($7), Savannah $8 ($6), Matanzas $12 (unchanged) and Durban $1 discount (zero).
